notes.title: Canyon Map and more
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37861153/27dc8b7b3ccab391f91c9a15f0f32a1be7b5fbe8.png[/img]

[h1]Brace yourselves[/h1]
It is finally here. A brand-new map for Hard2Fly. Featuring 4 new tracks of which one is supposed to be "super very easy". One track takes you around the Canyon in a not so difficult way. And then there is two more tracks that will get your heartrate up.

[h2]There is something else[/h2]
I cannot go into details here. But let’s just say the amount of tracks to fly didn't just double with the new map. It is now 16 different leaderboards for you to claim your ranks in. If you find it - you will know.

Enjoy!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]Content:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new Canyon map including 4 tracks
[*] Added a special for players to find and activate
[/list]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] On Fly-Maps: Manually set a new respawn position by holding right mouse button or right bumper
[*] Fly menu has a sub menu for map selection now
[*] Ghost Drones will be reset when changing the active track
[*] Debris is auto. cleared on track activation
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed some conditions in the Tutorial to avoid market areas from not spawning
[/list]
